# OpenShell protocol definitions

These four files are copied unchanged from NVIDIA OpenShell at tag `v0.1.2`
(<https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/tree/v0.1.2/proto>), under the Apache
License 2.0 in `LICENSE` beside this file.

`scripts/gen-proto.sh` generates the Python gRPC client in
`src/cmapolicy/_proto/` from them. To move to another OpenShell release, copy
that tag's files here and run the script again.
